description: Healthcare clinical software role with HIPAA and HL7 FHIR requirements

input.jobDescription:
Clinical Software Engineer at MedSystems

MedSystems builds EHR and clinical decision support software used by 500+ hospitals. We are hiring a Clinical Software Engineer to develop integrations with major healthcare systems.

Responsibilities:
- Develop HL7 FHIR R4 APIs for clinical data exchange
- Build integrations with Epic and Cerner EHR systems
- Ensure all systems comply with HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules
- Implement audit logging and access controls for PHI
- Collaborate with clinical informatics specialists

Required Skills:
- .NET (C#) or Java — our primary backend stacks
- HL7 FHIR R4 specification and SMART on FHIR
- RESTful API design
- SQL Server or PostgreSQL
- HIPAA compliance and security best practices

Desired:
- Epic App Orchard certification
- Experience with ICD-10 and SNOMED CT coding systems
- Clinical informatics background

This role requires passing a background check. Full-time, in Boston or remote.

Apply through medsystems.com/careers
